title: Braids, normed division algebras, and Standard Model symmetries
note: arXiv:1803.02202v2 [physics.gen-ph], 16 Mar 2018. Page 1 reads 'Prepared for submission to JHEP'; no journal reference is printed, so none is added. Ingested 2026-11-22 as library/arxiv-1803.02202v2/ from an owner chat upload. Identifies helon framed braids in B_3^c with the basis states of Furey's minimal left ideals of the complex octonions (Cl(6)); SU(3)_c and U(1)_em come from the octonionic ideals, not from the braiding. HUMAN-REVIEW: unreviewed.
